content.text: You keep a wiki of skill-selection failures. Read the staged traces. Each trace has the task text, the offered index, the loads, and the ground-truth skill. Write pattern pages named selection-<what happened>, for example selection-missed-heat-when-microwave-mentioned. finish with the four paper fields create_patterns, update_patterns, update_index, append_log. update_index must mention every pattern stem. Do not edit selection-impact, bodies, descriptions, or catalog.

## iteration 0 baseline
- look_at_obj_in_light: Procedure for examining an object under a light.
- pick_and_place: Procedure for picking up one object and putting it somewhere.
- pick_clean_then_place: Procedure for cleaning an object and then putting it somewhere.

## iteration 1 accept
- look_at_obj_in_light: Use when the task is to look at, examine, or inspect an object under a desklamp or floorlamp (e.g. 'look at the alarmclock under the desklamp', 'hold a pencil and turn on the lamp'). Involves turning on the lamp while holding the object.
- pick_and_place: Use for a plain single-object move: take one object and put/move it in or on a destination (e.g. 'put the blue vase in the safe', 'move keys from shelf to desktop'). No heating, cooling, cleaning, lamp, or count of two.
- pick_clean_then_place: Use when the task says to clean/wash an object (e.g. 'put a clean plate in the cabinet'): take it, clean at the sinkbasin, then place it at the destination.
- pick_cool_then_place: Use when the task says to cool, chill, or make an object cold (e.g. 'put a cold apple on the table'): take it, cool in the fridge, then place it.
- pick_heat_then_place: Use when the task says to heat, warm, or cook an object (e.g. 'put a hot potato on the countertop', 'cook a plate of food then put it in the fridge'): heat in the microwave, then place it.
- pick_two_obj_and_place: Use when the task states a count of two objects (e.g. 'put two spray bottles in the bin', 'two spatulas in the drawer'): find and place both, one at a time, at the destination.

{"proposal": {"create_patterns":[{"name":"selection-nothing-loaded-for-cleaned-adjective","content":"# Nothing loaded when 'cleaned' is used as an adjective

Task: 'Put cleaned soap on the counter.' Ground truth is pick_clean_then_place. The agent loaded nothing.

The cue is a form of clean, such as cleaned, clean or wash. It can appear mid-phrase with no sink mentioned. Treat any such word as a trigger for pick_clean_then_place.

Seen in t5."},{"name":"selection-nothing-loaded-for-throw-away-or-take-paraphrase","content":"# Nothing loaded when the move is phrased as throw away, take, or put in a container

These tasks were all plain single-object moves. Ground truth is pick_and_place. The agent loaded nothing.
- 'Throw away the spray bottle on the counter' (t7)
- 'Take a set of keys to the desk' (t4)
- 'Put a bottle in a waste basket' (t3)
- 'Put a phone on the black dresser' (t1)
- 'Put a cloth in the drawer' (t6)

The verb is not always 'put'. Throw away, take to and place all mean a move. 'A set of' is not a count of two. If there is no heat, cool, clean, lamp or two cue, load pick_and_place. Never load nothing."}],"update_patterns":[],"update_index":"Patterns: selection-nothing-loaded-for-plain-move (t1, t6); selection-nothing-loaded-for-throw-away-or-take-paraphrase (t1, t3, t4, t6, t7); selection-nothing-loaded-for-cleaned-adjective (t5); selection-nothing-loaded-for-two-count; selection-nothing-loaded-for-clean-with-microwave-destination; selection-lamp-examine-task-labeled-pick-and-place (t2, which was labeled pick_and_place although the lamp skill was loaded); selection-no-skill-loaded-for-plain-pick-and-place; selection-missed-two-object-when-count-two-stated; selection-lamp-mentioned-confusion-examine-vs-turn-on; selection-missed-heat-when-cook-mentioned.","append_log":"Read t1-t8.
